scope: Stable POSIX process-group ownership primitive; no production Broker/bridge integration in this commit
limitation: A live new-session escape is demonstrated. Group cleanup is not full process-tree containment.

limitations: Lower-level lifecycle primitive only; production bridge is not wired to it
POSIX groups permit new-session escape; live escape counterexample is an expected limitation test
Windows skips POSIX native integration; macOS and hosted exact-SHA matrix not yet observed
Local Node processes without real external model or account; not release acceptance

assertions.name: owned POSIX group: real processes preserves exact stdout, Unicode argv/environment and successful target exit
owned POSIX group: real processes decodes a multi-chunk Unicode launch without changing target arguments
owned POSIX group: real processes cleans an ignoring descendant after the original root exits normally
owned POSIX group: real processes keeps the group leader alive when the root exits on TERM
owned POSIX group: real processes cleans two TERM-ignoring processes after repeated cancellation
owned POSIX group: real processes forwards hard cancellation through the living group owner
owned POSIX group: real processes does not load target NODE_OPTIONS into the supervisor
owned POSIX group: real processes reports missing executables and still confirms group cleanup
owned POSIX group: real processes cleans on a lost caller lifeline without inventing a control receipt
owned POSIX group: real processes reports only group cleanup when a descendant escapes with a new session
owned POSIX group: real processes never sends signals through an exited leader's numeric identity
owned POSIX group ownership contract does not treat a supervisor close as cleanup: null
owned POSIX group ownership contract does not treat a supervisor close as cleanup: "S"
owned POSIX group ownership contract does not treat a supervisor close as cleanup: "?"
owned POSIX group ownership contract requires an intentional cleanup receipt even when no live group remains
owned POSIX group ownership contract does not upgrade zombie-only groups to hostile descendant containment
owned POSIX group ownership contract de-duplicates stop requests and escalates once without native kill
owned POSIX group ownership contract rejects malformed control output without signalling a stale PID
owned POSIX group ownership contract does not silently accept descriptor, shell, or sandbox options
owned POSIX group ownership contract fails closed on macOS probe errors and unparseable snapshots
process spawn inventory audit separates lexical noise from executable process calls
process spawn inventory audit recognizes direct and default-seam Broker routing
process spawn inventory audit applies explicit host-boundary exemptions
process spawn inventory audit does not hide a multiline dynamic child_process load behind a string literal
process spawn inventory audit fails the current runtime inventory closed at zero unreviewed
